task.title: Add Activity view with filtering and full log
task.description:
Add a full Activity view to the app. (1) Add Activity nav item to sidebar between Batch Outreach and Integrations: . (2) Add view HTML:

Activity

. (3) Add renderActivityView() function: reads ga(), filters by actSearch text and actDateF range, sorts reverse-chronological, paginates 20 per page. Shows each item identically to dashboard activity but with the contact name as a clickable green link opening openHistory(). Shows total count above list. Pagination shows Previous/Next buttons and page indicator. (4) Add case to showView(): if(name==='activity')renderActivityView(). (5) Add search and date filter event listeners for actSearch and actDateF. (6) On dashboard, add a 'View All →' link below the activity list that calls showView('activity').
task.project_vision: Frontend-only AI outreach SaaS. Single HTML file. localStorage. Surgical edits only.

blocking_issues: Mobile navigation is completely inaccessible - sidebar is hidden on mobile with no hamburger menu or alternative navigation method to access Dashboard, Clients, Policies, Claims, Analytics sections
Logout button touch target (min-height: 44px) in mobile header requires scrolling/interaction but no accessible tap area is visible for the actual logout action
Modal close buttons lack accessible labels/aria-labels - screen readers cannot identify close functionality
All interactive table rows marked 'clickable' have no keyboard accessibility (no tabindex, no enter/space handlers)
Form validation errors show visual styling but no aria-invalid or aria-describedby attributes for screen readers
Mobile contact cards rendering logic causes infinite loop - function renderContacts() has duplicate mobile check and calls itself recursively with renderMobileContacts() which doesn't exist
Email validation blocks saving contact entirely - should warn but allow save since email is not in CT_REQUIRED_FIELDS
saveContact() function is truncated mid-line - critical functionality is incomplete
Mobile navigation is completely inaccessible - sidebar is hidden on mobile but no hamburger menu or mobile nav implementation exists
Touch targets on mobile logout button (44px min-height) may be insufficient for other interactive elements - nav items, buttons in modals lack proper touch target sizing
Modal scrolling may fail on iOS - needs -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch for .modal-box
Form inputs lack proper error announcements for screen readers - missing aria-invalid and aria-describedby attributes
Email validation blocks save but error state is not cleared when user corrects input (no input event listener to remove 'invalid' class)
Duplicate `const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;` declarations in renderContacts() cause syntax error/confusion
saveContact() function is truncated mid-expression - incomplete code will cause runtime error
Settings gear icon displays as '�gear;' - character encoding issue breaks settings navigation visibility
